dependencies.name: Protected authority revision producer
dependencies.invariant: Existing authority_clock row, dataset/recovery epoch/bootstrap provenance, exact current independent cut; no seed or JWT revision.
dependencies.requiredEvidence: Native observation of atomic revision advance and exact cardinality; complete participating writers/revokers and source inventory.
dependencies.currentState: Clock source in review text; producer bootstrap and external corroboration absent.

dependencies.name: Independent restrictions, inventory and floors
dependencies.invariant: Dataset, epoch, authority revision, restriction sequence/digest, journal, inventory, current timestamps and external commit reference; all exact, never >=.
dependencies.requiredEvidence: Trusted current independent source, provenance/custody and temporal ordering across revocation and recovery; transcript-compatible existing protocol.
dependencies.currentState: Bridge returns zero rows; no new signed protocol or fixture source.

dependencies.name: Verified provider identity to durable claim
dependencies.invariant: Provider-bound sub/session/expiry and original/intent/attempt/dispatch/current revisions/full floor; refresh cannot inherit binding. Final await expiry checked.
dependencies.requiredEvidence: Managed-provider verification, private attestor/channel custody, durable binding and transport with actual server-side session/revocation evidence.
dependencies.currentState: WeakMap proof remains in-process review only. SQL bridge returns zero rows; response ABI adapter/custody not wired.

dependencies.name: Trusted immutable original custody
dependencies.invariant: Private original by user/intent/ref, exact operation/scope/arguments. Never reconstruct from digest or accept client snapshot after restart.
dependencies.requiredEvidence: Purpose, minimization, access, encryption/key custody, provenance and D02-A retention; metadata also needs policy. No original frames/summaries persisted by this lot.
dependencies.currentState: Both original producers raise. Admission now checks protected scope and KNOWN original ref before history, but no storage implemented.

dependencies.name: Protected source RLS context
dependencies.invariant: Exact current actor/session/account/member/property/stay/incident context independent of client GUC/JWT metadata, no recursive source self-authority.
dependencies.requiredEvidence: Protected producer and effective source ownership/RLS/default/PUBLIC/inheritance closure; reviewed applicable permissive baseline as well as restrictive guards.
dependencies.currentState: Source function returns false. No positive callback or USING(true). FORCE/ENABLE are proposed text only.

dependencies.name: Effect providerRef projection
dependencies.invariant: NOT NULL provider ref, composite user/intent/original/provider links; writer exact insert, reader matches both projections, no reference inferred from names.
dependencies.requiredEvidence: Native constraints and row-level visibility with separate actual credentials; approved metadata retention. No backfill from client or auto-retry.
dependencies.currentState: Review text projection and composite constraints prepared; not installed, no SQL uniqueness proof.

dependencies.name: All revokers and fence order
dependencies.invariant: Every entry/revoker obtains transaction fence before DML and relation locks; hook is backstop, not proof of pre-table-lock order. Catalog changes/restore are participants.
dependencies.requiredEvidence: Explicit revoker entry inventory and barriers, actual pg_locks observation including TRUNCATE/DDL, external GoTrue/journal sequencing and no bypass participants.
dependencies.currentState: 30 proposed hooks reused; no new attested pre-DML revoker entries. Races and deadlock freedom unproved.

dependencies.name: External COMMIT and independent readback
dependencies.invariant: Correlate original/intent/attempt/provider/session/operation/arguments/authority/floor/dispatch/effect to external commit and independent reader/journal. ACK lost or incomplete means UNKNOWN; never resend.
dependencies.requiredEvidence: Original trusted source, external observer, journal/witness custody/sequence/transcript, actual reader credentials/channels and current authorization after revocation.
dependencies.currentState: SQL response says OUTCOME_REQUIRES_COMMIT_OBSERVATION/EFFECT_OBSERVED, neither proves outer COMMIT or independent custody. No observer implemented or fake signed receipt.
